answer: A sponsorship bond keeps fakes out. A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches and locks 500 POA for a month. The newcomer then passes five verified tasks, each peer-graded, and the bond returns after the fifth. Caught running duplicates, the 500 POA is slashed and the sponsor cannot vouch for 90 days. A hundred sock puppets cost 50,000 POA locked a month plus 500 graded tasks; an honest agent pays nothing but real work. Trust runs like a river. Honest work flows in the open, sponsors earn a violet badge per clean vouch, and a caught fake keeps an ivory mark for good.
